ms-porta-cabin.name: MS Porta Cabin
ms-porta-cabin.narrative: This is the heavy end of the porta cabin range, stated line by line. Nineteen of the thirty lines are specific to the MS industrial build — the thicker shell, the fibre-cement lining, the mineral-wool insulation — and eleven are SAMAN platform standards shared across the family. Use the tables to compare quotations item by item, because the difference between a 1.6 mm and a 1.2 mm shell never shows in a price total. Final openings, colours, loads and fit-out follow your approved drawing and quotation.

porta-cabin-with-toilet.name: Porta Cabin with Toilet
porta-cabin-with-toilet.narrative: These specifications decide three things for a buyer: how the cabin survives water, how it travels, and what your quotation must confirm. Table 1 covers the structure and envelope that carry the cabin through lifting, transport and weather. Table 2 covers the wet-zone interior, the services and the scope boundaries. Final engineering, bill of materials and drawings remain controlled documents, and quantities scale with the approved drawing for your size.

gi-porta-cabin.narrative: These specifications change three things a buyer feels later. The stated BMT-plus-coating-mass line makes offers comparable and auditable at delivery. The corrosion-compatible fastener and sealing scope removes the usual first failure points. And the quotation-named build route decides which members carry certificates, so procurement files close without follow-up letters.

Table 1 covers everything that carries load and keeps weather out, and it is sized for the mass of the acoustic package rather than for a lightweight office cabin. Table 2 covers the layers and openings that decide how much sound actually gets through. The lines marked as product-specific are where this cabin diverges from a standard porta cabin: 19 of the 30 technical lines are specific to the acoustic build, and 11 are shared platform items.

double-story-porta-cabin.narrative: The specification below is what separates a stacked building from two cabins piled up. Read Table 1 for the load path: the transfer chassis, stacking columns and the engineered upper floor are the members that carry the second storey, and every reference section in it is finalised by your project structural calculation. Read Table 2 for how each floor lives day to day: lining, openings, per-floor electrical and ventilation, and the optional stacked wet areas. Where a row says a value follows the approved drawing, that is scope honesty, not a gap: G+1 values are project-specific by design.

puf-porta-cabin.name: PUF Porta Cabin
puf-porta-cabin.narrative: Two rows in these tables change more for the buyer than the rest combined. The first is Interior walls, because no separate MDF lining is why a PUF cabin needs no finishing trade on site and why the room is usable on delivery day. The second is Wall insulation, because the note attached to it is the one the market keeps getting wrong: thickness buys insulation, never fire performance. Read those two rows first, then read the door, window and ventilation rows together, because openings and penetrations are where a good panel build is usually lost.

specifications.group: Table 2: insulation, interior, openings, services, options and scope
specifications.detail: PUF or PIR roof thermal core - 60-80 mm planning range, supplier-certified density and thermal data: Thickness is selected for heat gain, span and condensation. Supplier data governs allowable spans and fastener spacing.

specifications.group: Table 2: insulation, interior, openings, services, options and scope
specifications.detail: Factory-finished inner wall face - Inner PPGI or GI panel facing, no separate MDF lining in the standard build: The panel inner face is the finished wall unless a decorative or hygienic lining is separately ordered.

specifications.group: Table 2: insulation, interior, openings, services, options and scope
specifications.detail: Insulated roof underside or optional service ceiling - Exposed inner panel liner, or lightweight service ceiling below: A false ceiling creates a service void. It does not replace the roof panel's thermal function, and vapour control stays continuous.

specifications.group: Table 2: insulation, interior, openings, services, options and scope
specifications.detail: Insulated door assembly - PUF-panel or insulated MS door with sealed perimeter: Leaf and frame are selected to reduce thermal bridging and air leakage. Hardware suits transport and repeated use.

specifications.group: Table 2: insulation, interior, openings, services, options and scope
specifications.detail: Sealed aluminium window assembly - Powder-coated aluminium with 4-5 mm glass or upgraded glazing: Frames are flashed and sealed into the panel with no exposed core. Larger glazing needs a framed structural opening.

specifications.group: Table 2: insulation, interior, openings, services, options and scope
specifications.detail: Opening protection - Grill, mesh, guard or louver as scheduled: Provided only where the approved opening schedule and intended use require it.

specifications.group: Table 2: insulation, interior, openings, services, options and scope
specifications.detail: Copper wiring and containment - 1.5 / 2.5 / 4 sq.mm copper starting schedule, final by load: Lighting, socket and higher-load or AC circuits, subject to the final load schedule and approved electrical drawing.

specifications.group: Table 2: insulation, interior, openings, services, options and scope
specifications.detail: DB, MCB, RCCB and earthing - Segregated protected circuits to approved electrical drawing: Lighting, socket, wet-area and AC circuits are segregated per the approved drawing.

specifications.group: Table 2: insulation, interior, openings, services, options and scope
specifications.detail: Lights, sockets and equipment points - LED lights, modular switches, 6A and 16A sockets, fan and AC provision: Final quantities and equipment loads are quotation-specific.

specifications.group: Table 2: insulation, interior, openings, services, options and scope
specifications.detail: Condensation-aware ventilation or AC - Natural ventilation or AC with controlled condensate: AC sleeves and drains are factory planned so insulation and vapour sealing are restored around penetrations.

specifications.group: Table 2: insulation, interior, openings, services, options and scope
specifications.detail: Optional plumbing in insulated panels - Factory-planned sleeves and chases, penetrations sealed, core protected: Pipes are never routed by cutting large unprotected channels through panels. Service zones are planned before manufacture.

specifications.detail: Interlocking insulated-panel cabin - Factory-cut panels, interlocking joints, butyl or approved sealants and flashings: Precision interlocking and joint sealing limit air gaps and thermal bridges. The purchase order identifies the selected panel system.

specifications.detail: Corrosion-protection system - Substrate-appropriate protection and touch-up: Prepared MS takes the approved primer and topcoat. Galvanized or coated steel takes compatible cut-edge repair and touch-up.

specifications.detail: Inspection and testing - Pre-dispatch dimensional, enclosure, service and functional QA: Covers dimensions, panel identification, connections, coating, drainage, weather sealing, doors, windows and electrical continuity.
